why: The refusal that keeps a full-screen destination from opening under a modal is deleted, so a route push while a confirmation is up succeeds: the Levels grid opens over the dialog the player was answering, and the next Back closes the grid and drops the player back INTO a confirmation they had already navigated away from. The LIFO order the module claims by construction (an overlay is always above every route) stops being true. Fails 1 of 15 in navigation.test.ts: `a route pushed over an open overlay is refused and the stack is unchanged`, at its `'refused'` assertion. The overlay-over-overlay control in the same case still passes, which is what shows the assertion is about the route/overlay pairing and not about any push over an overlay.
